categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Directly modifies `src/bitcoin-tx.cpp`, which is explicitly covered by the tools category.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where malformed CLI arguments with extra colon separators silently ignore script wrapper flags and emit bare scripts instead of returning an error. While `bitcoin-tx` touches transactions directly, this issue requires malformed input to trigger, making the fix worthwhile input hardening rather than urgent.
